items: Generate: mumkina hal banana, tasadufi, munazzam ya heuristic (tajurbati qaida) se.
Test: hal ko masle ki sharait ya pabandiyon par jaanchna. Sab poori karta ho to durust; warna naya hal bana kar dohrana.

blocks.alt: Baen: flowchart jo shuru ho kar integer maangta, x parhta, jaanchta ke x % 2 == 0 hai aur khatam hone se pehle Even ya Odd likhta hai, input, process, output, ghair wazeh masle aur chaar qism ke masail ke notes ke saath. Daen: generator dabba mumkina hal tester dabbe ko deta hai; durust hal stop tak aur ghalat hal wapas generator tak jata hai, qadmon, faidon aur nuqsanaat ke notes ke saath.
blocks.caption: Wazeh masla aur generate and test ka chakkar (topics 3.1 aur 3.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Yeh jaanchna ke adad juft hai, wazeh masla hai: input ek integer, process use 2 se taqseem kar ke baqi dekhta, aur output Even ya Odd hai. Flowchart shuru ho kar paigham likhta, x parhta, baqi 0 ho to true shaakh se Even likhta warna false shaakh se Odd, aur phir khatam hota hai. Generate and test mein generator mumkina hal pesh karta aur tester use sharait par jaanchta hai; ghalat hal amal ko naya hal banane wapas bhejta, aur durust hal use rok deta hai.

blocks.prompt: Generate and Test algorithm ke bunyadi qadam bataiye (short question 2).
blocks.explanation: 1 umeedwar hal banayein; 2 use tamam sharait par jaanchein; 3 paas ho to usi hal par ruk jayein; 4 warna agla umeedwar bana kar phir jaanchein, jab tak hal na mile ya umeedwar khatam na hon.

items: Do qadam: generate (tasadufi, munazzam ya heuristic) aur test (tamam pabandiyon par), durust hone tak chakkar.
